subject: Temporary handback & phased destruction playbook — bespoke timelines for HelioThera
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@heliothera.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Esposito <marco.esposito@heliothera.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Bespoke temporary residency + phased destruction — initial ask

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — HelioThera is leaning toward Redwood for inference, but our security/legal team needs clarification on a bespoke retention handback flow. Two core asks: 1) We need a temporary residency window for PII-enriched inference data (not model weights) that is longer than default (we're thinking 180 days), and 2) when the window ends we require a phased destruction process with certified wipe artifacts and an option to escrow a snapshot for 30 days before final destroy.

Can Redwood support a 180-day temporary residency with a two-stage destruction (30-day escrow hold + final wipe), and if so, what will the SLA/order form language look like (order form amendment + required evidence artifacts)? Also: timeline for providing a signed order form and any implications for Dedicated vs Hosted.

Appreciate a short playbook we can attach to our procurement request.

Thanks,
Samantha
Director, Security & Compliance
HelioThera

Attachments: None
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@heliothera.com>
Cc: Marco Esposito <marco.esposito@heliothera.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bespoke temporary residency + phased destruction — initial ask

Hi Samantha — thanks for laying this out clearly. We can support the flow you describe and have two workable approaches depending on controls you need:

Option A — Hosted (redwood-managed):
- Temporary residency: configurable per-account window (90/120/180 days).
- Phased destruction: automatic move to escrow for N days (default 30) after window expiry, then certified wipe with SHA256 destruction report.
- Evidence: issuance of a destruction certificate + retention report; we can also provide a download URL to encrypted destroy logs.

Option B — Dedicated (reserved capacity / customer VPC):
- Same timeline mechanics but with customer-managed KMS and ability to run customer-side verification tooling before final wipe.
- On-request expedited restoration from escrow within the hold window.

Questions so we can prepare a playbook and redline the order form:
1) Is the 30-day escrow mandatory or do you want an optional shorter 14-day window for certain data classes?
2) Do you require a destruction affidavit signed by Redwood legal or is a technical destruction certificate sufficient?
3) Any regulatory constraints (e.g., finance vs clinical) that would require geo-locked deletion or additional attestations?

I've attached a short matrix (redwood-bespoke-handback-options-v1.pdf) that maps timelines to artifact types and order-form clauses. Karthik — looping you to confirm wording for the SLA exhibit and whether we need to route this to Legal for an addendum.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-bespoke-handback-options-v1.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@heliothera.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 14:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bespoke temporary residency + phased destruction — initial ask

Hi all — quick technical clarifications and recommended SLA text.

Technical notes:
- Implementation: We implement a lifecycle policy that tags inference payloads and enforces retention windows via a tenant-scoped eviction queue. On expiry, objects are tombstoned and moved to an encrypted escrow store for the hold period. Final wipe uses a multi-pass overwrite for on-prem or crypto-shredding for cloud-backed volumes, followed by log generation.
- Evidence: destruction certificate includes: object id range, UTC timestamp, hash summary, wiping method, and operator id. For cloud-hosted customers we additionally export an audit bundle (gzip) with timestamps and KV-cache purge events.

Recommended SLA exhibit language (proposed short form):
- "Temporary Residency Window": Redwood agrees to retain specified customer inference data for X days from ingestion (X configurable; default 30; customer-selected).
- "Escrow Hold": Upon residency expiry, Redwood will move data to a secure escrow for Y days (default 30) during which restoration is possible on written request.
- "Final Destruction": At escrow expiration Redwood will perform final destruction and produce a Destruction Certificate within 7 business days.
- "Evidence Delivery": Destruction Certificate and an Audit Bundle will be delivered via secure link to the customer's security contact.

Operational impacts / SLAs:
- Hosted customers choosing X>=180 will see a 2–4 week onboarding window for retention rules and compliance verification.
- Dedicated customers can choose customer-managed KMS and tighter deletion attestations; this may affect cost (we propose a 12% uplift for dedicated retention guarantees).

Rishi — can you confirm the 7-business-day window for certificate issuance and whether the 12% uplift sounds reasonable?

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@heliothera.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bespoke temporary residency + phased destruction — initial ask

Confirming the operational/legal knobs:
- 7 business days to generate and deliver the Destruction Certificate is acceptable. We'll record the artifact in our compliance ledger and provide customer with an immutable link and a signed PDF.
- The 12% uplift for a Dedicated retention SLA with customer-managed KMS is our suggested baseline; we can formalize pricing in the order form appendix.
- For escrow hold variants: we can support 14/30/60-day holds. If HelioThera requires conditional holds (e.g., extend only for flagged records), we'll need a short integration to pass flags via our API (estimated 2 weeks dev work).

Mina — propose we send a concise order form exhibit (SLA Exhibit B) that enumerates: residency window, escrow duration, evidence artifacts, certificate SLA, pricing uplift (if dedicated), and restoration request process.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@heliothera.com>
Cc: Marco Esposito <marco.esposito@heliothera.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Final: SLA Exhibit & DocuSign for HelioThera (HT-4821)

Samantha — thanks for the clarifications on regulatory scope earlier today. Per our internal review we've prepared the SLA Exhibit B and a short playbook (attached) outlining the 180-day temporary residency + 30-day escrow hold + final destruction flow.

Key points summarized for signature:
- Residency: 180 days from ingestion for tagged inference data class.
- Escrow hold: 30 days after residency expiry; restoration possible by written request within that window.
- Destruction certificate: Redwood will deliver within 7 business days of final destruction; certificate includes object id ranges, SHA256 summaries, wipe method, operator id.
- Evidence delivery: secure link to audit bundle and signed PDF certificate.
- Pricing: If HelioThera selects Dedicated with customer-managed KMS, a 12% retention SLA uplift applies (see Order Form Appendix C).

Attached: redwood-bespoke-handback-options-v1.pdf, phased-destruction-diagram.svg
DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABCDEF123456
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/HT-4821

Please review and sign. If you want any language tweaks (e.g., changing escrow to 60 days for particular data classes), let me know and we can send an amendment.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
